analysis: Examined MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngine.swift units. Base 1436-1974 covers the native media submit path, the deadline-checked event stream, and makeEventStream forwarding/terminal/release logic. Base 1975-2081 covers the test hook, tokenize/applyTemplate, resolveTokenizer and telemetry. Head 1-518 covers init, cache scope, acquisition and preparation. None of these lines fall in the changed ranges. Changed ranges are head 1024-1035, 1078 and 1108-1173; the visible patch adds GenerationLoopExitThinkingPolicy.resolve. That policy is disabled when logprobs are present and when the bridge serves a distributed pair; the `!= false` comparison also disables it when the bridge is nil. The patch hoists stopStringScope and adds a new block at 1108-1169 that was truncated in the excerpt and is not visible in these units. Cache scope handling is unchanged (T-041): cacheScope/nativeLocalCacheScope at head 500-501 is local-only for diffusion, and remote requests keep the coordinator-authored salt. Release and cancel paths in makeEventStream are unchanged. Integration should verify head 1108-1173, the new exit-thinking/loop-guard behavior, for these properties: (1) it cannot emit withheld reasoning as visible content; (2) it does not alter usage/billing counts (completionTokens and attempt usage); (3) it does not bypass tool or response_format validation; (4) it preserves T-010 cancellation and release-on-every-exit. No regression identified in the supplied units.
